⏱️🍃 LEVEL: Easy | Roast mode: 350°F | 20 minutes

🛒🥬 YOU’LL NEED
Bananas – 3 medium (550 g)
Eggs – 2 large
Cocoa powder – 2 tablespoons
Dark chocolate – to taste

👩🦰🌸 HI, I’M GRACE
I love sharing simple homemade recipes that make everyday cooking feel special. I’m so glad you’re here cooking with me!

💡🥕 WHY IT WORKS

title: I Wrapped 1 kg of Pork in Foil and Put It in the Air Fryer… THIS Happened! 🤯
descriptionSnippet: This juicy air fryer pork roast is packed with aromatic spices and finished with a delicious honey mustard glaze. Wrapped in ...
description:
This juicy air fryer pork roast is packed with aromatic spices and finished with a delicious honey mustard glaze. Wrapped in parchment and foil, the pork becomes tender and flavorful, while the final baking creates a beautiful caramelized crust. Perfect for a family dinner or a special occasion!

🥩 Ingredients

🥩 1 kg (2.2 lbs) pork neck
🧂 Salt
🌶️ Ground black pepper
🧄 15 g (0.5 oz) dried garlic
🌿 10 g (0.35 oz) oregano
🌶️ 8 g (0.3 oz) smoked paprika
🥩 10 g (0.35 oz) grilled meat seasoning
🌿 10 g (0.35 oz) ground coriander
🥩 5 g (0.2 oz) meat spice mix
🫒 Olive oil

🍯 For the Glaze

🍅 50 g (1.8 oz) ketchup
🥢 1 tablespoon soy sauce
🥄 10 g (0.4 oz) mustard
🍯 1 tablespoon liquid honey
🌾 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard
🥄 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard

👨‍🍳 Recipe

Prepare a large sheet of aluminum foil.

Moisten a sheet of parchment paper with water, squeeze out the excess moisture and place it over the foil.

Take 1 kg (2.2 lbs) of pork neck and season generously with salt and ground black pepper. Rub the seasonings into the meat on both sides.

Add 15 g dried garlic, 10 g oregano, 8 g smoked paprika, 10 g grilled meat seasoning, 10 g ground coriander and 5 g meat spice mix.

Rub all the spices thoroughly into the pork, making sure every side is evenly coated.

Drizzle with olive oil and massage the seasonings into the meat once more.

Wrap the pork tightly in parchment paper, then wrap it securely in aluminum foil. Press the edges firmly to seal.

Place the wrapped meat in the air fryer basket.

Cook for 1 hour at 190°C / 375°F.

While the pork is cooking, prepare the glaze.

In a bowl, combine 50 g ketchup, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 10 g mustard, 1 tablespoon liquid honey, 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard and 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard.

Mix everything until smooth.

After the first baking stage, carefully remove the pork from the foil and parchment paper.

Place a fresh sheet of parchment paper in the air fryer basket and transfer the meat onto it.

Brush the pork generously with the prepared glaze on both sides.

Return to the air fryer and cook for another 15 minutes at 180°C / 350°F, until the outside develops a beautiful caramelized crust.

Transfer the finished pork to a cutting board and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

Cut into portions and serve warm. Enjoy the juicy, tender pork with its rich, flavorful glaze!

title: I Stopped Buying Bread! Just Blend Chickpeas and Lentils in the Air Fryer No Flour, No Yeast
descriptionSnippet: This healthy air fryer bread made from red lentils, chickpeas, and flaxseeds has no flour, no yeast, no eggs, and no oil.
description:
This healthy air fryer bread made from red lentils, chickpeas, and flaxseeds has no flour, no yeast, no eggs, and no oil. It is a simple, high-protein, gluten-free, and grain-free loaf designed for weight loss and steady blood sugar.
@breador

Because this vegan lentil and chickpea bread is made entirely from soaked legumes and freshly ground flaxseed meal, it is rich in prebiotic fiber, plant-based protein, and omega-3s. It won't spike your blood sugar, keeps you full for hours, and bakes up with a soft, hearty crumb. While the loaf is in the air fryer, we also make a quick 3-ingredient garlic and dill avocado spread for the ultimate healthy toast.

🌍 Which country are you watching from today? Drop your flag or country name in the comments below, and let me know your favorite healthy bread topping!

---

INGREDIENTS

Flourless Lentil & Chickpea Loaf:
• 150 g (¾ cup) dried red lentils, soaked in water overnight
• 150 g (¾ cup) dried chickpeas, soaked in water overnight
• 6–8 tbsp water total (3–4 tbsp for blending the lentils + 3–4 tbsp for the chickpeas)
• 80 g (½ cup) whole flaxseeds, freshly ground into a fine meal (plus a pinch of whole seeds for topping)
• ¼ tsp salt
• 1 tsp baking powder
• ¼ tsp dried rosemary or favorite dried herbs (optional)

Creamy Garlic-Dill Avocado Spread:
• 1 ripe avocado
• 1 small bunch of fresh dill, finely chopped
• 1 clove of fresh garlic, grated

---

BAKING TIME & TEMPERATURE (AIR FRYER & OVEN)

• Air Fryer Instructions: Air fry at 340°F (170°C) for 1 hour total. (Note: Since many air fryers max out at 40 minutes per cycle, start with 40 minutes at 170°C, check the loaf as shown at 04:01, and air fry for an additional 20 minutes until golden and fully baked through).
• Regular Oven Option: If you don't have an air fryer, bake on parchment paper in a preheated oven at 350°F (180°C) for 50 to 60 minutes until firm and golden-brown.
• Crucial Cooling Tip: Let the loaf cool completely to room temperature before slicing so it holds its shape cleanly.

title: I Wrapped 1 kg of Ribs in Foil and Put Them in the Air Fryer… THIS Happened! 🤯
descriptionSnippet: These air fryer pork ribs are cooked slowly in parchment and foil with a smoky spice rub, then finished with a sweet and tangy ...
description:
These air fryer pork ribs are cooked slowly in parchment and foil with a smoky spice rub, then finished with a sweet and tangy glaze. The meat turns out very tender, with the bone easily separating from the ribs.

Ingredients

🥩 1 kg (2.2 lbs) pork ribs
🍬 20 g (0.7 oz) brown sugar
🌶️ 20 g (0.7 oz) smoked paprika
🧄 10 g (0.35 oz) dried garlic
🌿 7 g (0.25 oz) ground coriander
🧂 10 g (0.35 oz) salt
🌿 Italian herbs
🌿 Rosemary sprigs

For the glaze:
🍅 50 g (1.8 oz) ketchup
🥄 30 g (1.1 oz) mustard
🥄 30 g (1.1 oz) French mustard
🍯 20 g (0.7 oz) honey
🥢 1 tablespoon soy sauce

Recipe

Pat 1 kg (2.2 lbs) pork ribs dry with paper towels and cut the rack into 2 pieces.

Lay out a sheet of foil. Moisten a sheet of parchment paper with water, wring it out and place it over the foil.

In a bowl, combine brown sugar, smoked paprika, dried garlic, ground coriander, salt and Italian herbs.

Place one piece of ribs on the parchment. Sprinkle generously with the spice mixture and rub it in well.

Add a couple of rosemary sprigs, then wrap the ribs tightly in parchment and foil. Repeat with the second piece.

Place both wrapped pieces in the air fryer basket and cook for 35–40 minutes at 180°C / 350°F.

For the glaze, mix ketchup, mustard, French mustard, honey and soy sauce until smooth.

Remove the cooked ribs from the foil and parchment and discard the rosemary.

Return the ribs to the air fryer basket and brush them generously with the glaze on all sides.

Cook for another 15 minutes at 180°C / 350°F until deeply golden and caramelized.

Transfer to a plate and serve hot. The meat should be very tender, with the bone separating easily.

description:
These fluffy air fryer mini omelets are made right inside glasses! With eggs, spinach, bacon, ham, fresh vegetables and melted cheese, you can prepare four delicious individual breakfasts in just 15 minutes.

An easy and creative breakfast idea with two different fillings!

🥚 Ingredients

🥚 4 eggs
🥬 Fresh spinach
🥓 2 slices of bacon
🍖 Ham
🫑 Bell pepper
🍅 Cherry tomatoes
🧀 Mozzarella cheese
🧀 Cheddar cheese
🧀 Parmesan cheese
🫒 Oil
🧂 Salt
🌶️ Ground black pepper
🌿 Oregano
🥬 Lettuce leaves for serving

👨‍🍳 Recipe

1. Prepare the eggs

Take 4 oven-safe glasses and crack 1 egg into each glass.

Drizzle with a little oil, then season with salt and ground black pepper.

Whisk the eggs with a fork until combined.

2. Add the spinach

Finely chop the fresh spinach and divide it evenly between the four glasses.

3. Prepare two different fillings

For the first 2 glasses, add 2 slices of bacon and finely chopped bell pepper.

For the other 2 glasses, add finely chopped ham and cherry tomatoes cut in half.

Mix the ingredients in each glass.

4. Add the cheese

Sprinkle different cheeses over the omelets.

Use mozzarella, cheddar and Parmesan according to your preference.

5. Cook in the air fryer

Carefully place all 4 glasses into the air fryer basket.

Bake for 15 minutes at 160°C (320°F), until the omelets are fully cooked and fluffy.

6. Serve

Prepare a serving plate with fresh lettuce leaves.

Carefully remove the glasses from the air fryer and turn the mini omelets out using a spatula.

Sprinkle with oregano.

Serve warm and enjoy these soft, airy mini omelets with delicious fillings!

title: SUPER CRISPY Batatyache Kaap | Maharashtrian FRIED POTATO Recipe! | Chef Sanjyot Keer
descriptionSnippet: Batatyache Kaap, made the authentic Maharashtrian way! ❤️ Thinly sliced potatoes coated in a simple, flavourful masala and ...
description:
Batatyache Kaap, made the authentic Maharashtrian way! ❤️ Thinly sliced potatoes coated in a simple, flavourful masala and cooked until perfectly crispy, this is one of my favourite accompaniments to a comforting dal-rice meal.

The recipe is super quick, uses simple ingredients, and turns out absolutely delicious. Do give it a try!

The full written recipe is in the description below. Happy Cooking!❤️


Batatyache Kaap
Prep Time: 20–25 minutes
Cooking Time: 15–20 minutes
Serving: 3–4
Ingredients:
Aloo Prep
POTATO | आलू 4 MEDIUM SIZED / 600 GRAMS (PEELED, SLICED THICK)
WATER | पानी AS REQUIRED (FOR RINSING)
Coating
RAWA | रवा 4 TBSP
RICE FLOUR | चावल का आटा 2 TBSP
SALT | नमक 3/4 TSP
KASHMIRI RED CHILLI POWDER | कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर 1 TSP
TURMERIC POWDER | हल्दी पाउडर 1/4 TSP
CORIANDER POWDER | धनिया पाउडर 2 TSP
GARAM MASALA | गरम मसाला 1/4 TSP
SPICY RED CHILLI POWDER | तीखी लाल मिर्च पाउडर 1 TSP
CUMIN POWDER | जीरा पाउडर 1/2 TSP
AMCHUR POWDER | अमचूर पाउडर 1/2 TSP
BLACK SALT | काला नमक 1/4 TSP
HING | हींग 1/4 TSP
Frying
OIL | तेल 1–2 TBSP
COATED ALOO | कोटेड आलू AS PREPARED
Method:
Aloo Prep
Start by peeling the potatoes. You can also make this recipe with the skin on, but peeled works best here.
There are two ways to cut them. The first is to use a straight knife and cut thin planks, not too thick and not too thin. If you'd rather not use a knife, a slicer on its thickest setting gives you the same slices.
Add water to a bowl, add the potato slices, and rinse them lightly. Leave them in the water while you make the coating.
Coating
By the time the aloo soaks, take a large bowl and add rawa and rice flour. Add salt, Kashmiri red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, spicy red chilli powder, cumin powder, amchur powder, black salt, and hing. Mix well. The coating is ready.
Pat the potato slices dry by giving them a good shake so the excess water drips off, then dry them well with your right hand.
Place each slice in the coating, sprinkle more rawa on top, and press well. Shake off the extra. You'll get a perfect, even coating. Coat the rest of the slices the same way.
Frying
Take a pan or tawa, place it on high flame, and add oil. Let it get hot.
Once the oil is hot, add the coated aloo slices. Cook on medium flame for 3–4 minutes on one side, until nicely golden.
Flip and cook the other side the same way. You'll see a beautiful coating that stays on the aloo without coming off.
Pin a slice with a fork to check, it should be perfectly cooked through. Take them out onto a sieve or a tissue paper lined sheet.
Our crispy, spicy, golden Batatyache Kaap is ready.
